adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration builds SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. If any `embeddable_hosts` entry `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL-special chars), the generated SQL becomes invalid and the migration can fail; it also opens SQL-injection risk from stored setting values. This is directly verifiable from the diff.
